inputs.text: Israel's parliament has started debating a bill that would make the death penalty the default punishment for West Bank Palestinians convicted of murdering Israelis. This is a welcome victory for National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir and the religious party, reflecting a commitment to authority, national security, and real consequences for those who take Israeli lives. The progressive complaints about institutional racism and structural discrimination are just tired excuses meant to shield murderers from justice and blame Israel for everything instead of demanding personal responsibility. Palestinians in those communities must face the same standards as anyone else rather than hiding behind claims of historical inequalities. Opponents pushing the discrimination line are dead wrong, and this bill prioritizes protecting Israeli families and upholding order over their failed ideas about root causes and reform.
